title: FTC's Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
supports: Opened with WebFetch (Guides revised 2023; page undated). Free products given with an expectation of promotion must be disclosed, even if returned; on TikTok a description-only disclosure is very unlikely to be clear, superimposed text suggested, audio and visual when both used; live streams need periodic or continuous disclosure and one in the description; platform tools not guaranteed; advertisers need training and monitoring programmes and should monitor a few months after a contract; discount-code reviewers must disclose; incentives cannot depend on positive reviews

title: TikTok Shop Referral Fee Updates - 2024
supports: TikTok refuses automated fetches; confirmed by WebSearch results showing this exact page on 2026-11-07. US referral fee raised to 6% per order on qualified transactions from 1 April 2024; refunds incur a refund administration fee of 20% of the refunded referral fee, capped at $5 per SKU from 15 May 2025. TikTok's category chart (2024) keeps most categories at 6% with some jewelry and pre-owned categories lower. Some 2026 trade reports describe a higher rate; not shown on TikTok's public pages on 2026-11-07, so least sure.

title: Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule: Questions and Answers
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Rule effective 21 October 2024; bans fake reviews, sentiment-conditioned incentives, undisclosed insider reviews, review suppression and fake social media indicators; incentives allowed without a sentiment condition, but undisclosed incentives may still break the FTC Act

title: Health Products Compliance Guidance
supports: Opened with WebFetch (first 100,000 characters read). Replaces the 1998 supplement guide; health claims need competent and reliable scientific evidence, RCTs the standard, anecdotes never enough; endorsements do not replace evidence; atypical testimonials deceptive and "results not typical" does not cure; before-and-after images can imply claims

title: Business Guide to the FTC's Mail, Internet, or Telephone Order Merchandise Rule
supports: Opened with WebFetch; September 2011, edited January 2025. Reasonable basis for shipping claims; 30-day default; delay notice with revised date and right to cancel; refunds within seven working days; sellers liable for fulfilment houses and drop shippers; no store credit in place of refunds

title: Informing Businesses about the INFORM Consumers Act
supports: Opened with WebFetch. High-volume seller: 200 or more sales and $5,000 or more in any continuous 12 months within 24; bank, tax and contact details collected and verified within 10 days; sellers with $20,000 or more disclose name, address and contact; annual certification; effective 27 June 2023

title: 16 CFR Part 233, Guides Against Deceptive Pricing (CFR 2024 edition)
publisher: US Government Publishing Office (govinfo), for the Federal Trade Commission
supports: Opened with WebFetch (PDF, read in full). Former price must be a bona fide price openly offered for a reasonably substantial period in the recent regular course of business; comparisons with other sellers' prices, list prices and free or BOGO offers; limited offers must be limited

title: Recognising ads: Social media and influencer marketing
supports: Opened with WebFetch; dated 6 Aug 2026. When content is an ad (incentive, connection, control, own brand, affiliate link or code); reliable labels Ad, Advert, Advertising, Ad Feature; likely insufficient: sponsored, gifted, aff, spon, ambassador hashtags, tags or codes alone; upfront placement; on TikTok intent clear before click or from the outset; platform tools may suffice if clear; rules applied to TikTok

title: Platform Commission Fee
supports: TikTok refuses automated fetches; confirmed by WebSearch results showing this exact page on 2026-11-07. UK commission fee of 9%, inclusive of applicable taxes including VAT. TikTok's UK commission rate policy pages describe lower rates for some categories and for new sellers.

title: ASA Ruling on Jemella Ltd t/a GHD in association with Emily Canham
supports: Opened with WebFetch; ruling 4 Nov 2020. TikTok video with a TODAY ONLY 20% off code under a paid contract; no upfront #ad; upheld

title: ASA Ruling on Simmer Ltd
supports: Opened with WebFetch; ruling 17 Sep 2025. TikTok paid ad reused a TV clip claiming meals curated by Michelin-starred chefs; chef had been junior staff for nine months; misleading, upheld

title: ASA Ruling on ZOVOO (Shenzhen) Technology Co Ltd
supports: Opened with WebFetch; ruling 13 Sep 2023. Unlicensed nicotine e-cigarette promoted on an influencer's public TikTok account; e-cigarette ads not permitted there (CAP rule 22.12); company did not respond; upheld

title: Social media endorsements: guidance for brands
supports: Opened with WebFetch; updated 28 Aug 2025. Contracts require upfront ad disclosure; gifts sent with instructions to label as Ad even if nothing is asked; gifts and commissions count as payment; brands check content and act on mislabelled posts; continuing with repeat failures is a risk

title: Fulfillment Policy
supports: TikTok refuses automated fetches; confirmed by WebSearch results showing this exact page on 2026-11-07. Regular orders marked In Transit within 2 business days of Awaiting Shipment; late dispatch rate recommended at 4% or below, enforcement possible above 10%; valid tracking rate 95% or more; on-time delivery rate 80% or more.

title: Short guide for businesses publishing consumer reviews
supports: Opened with WebFetch; published 4 Apr 2025. Fake reviews and concealed incentivised reviews banned; review publishers need a policy, a risk assessment, processes and reasonable and proportionate steps

title: Urgency claims and price reduction claims: compliance advice for online businesses (open letter and examples)
supports: Opened with WebFetch (PDF, read in full); 29 Mar 2023. Examples of misleading timers, follow-on offers, stock, popularity and sales-rate claims; comparison prices that are short-lived, rarely sold at, flip-flopping, old or undercut; keep evidence; review claims before A/B tests; refers to CTSI pricing practices guidance

title: Unfair commercial practices (CMA207)
supports: Opened with WebFetch, with the linked HTML guidance. Published 4 Apr 2025, updated 18 Nov 2025; DMCC Act guidance; falsely stating a product is available only for a limited time is a banned practice; bait pricing banned

title: CMA fines firms £6 million for misleading sales tactics
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 14 Oct 2026. Wayfair £4.8 million for false time-limited deals; Appliances Direct £1.2 million; Gold's Gym joining fee; DMCC fines up to 10% of global turnover or £300,000

title: Open letter to online retailers: including mandatory delivery fees in the total price
supports: Opened with WebFetch; 2 Nov 2026. Total price including mandatory delivery at every stage; marketplaces include each trader's delivery in that product's total; four drip pricing cases, fines over £5.1 million

title: Online and distance selling for businesses
supports: Opened with WebFetch (page undated). Information before an order including total price and delivery; 14 days to cancel from delivery, up to 12 months if not told; delivery within 30 days unless agreed

title: Influencer Legal Hub
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no page date; items to February 2026). Brand partnerships and affiliate marketing must be disclosed; creators who regularly sell are traders; sellers give identity and product information and respect returns; check Safety Gate and do not sell recalled products; national sweep figures (Ireland 48.4% in 2022, Spain 77.75% preliminary)

title: Guarantees and returns: returns
supports: Opened with WebFetch; last checked by the publisher 28 Apr 2026. 14-day withdrawal from delivery for goods; exceptions such as perishable, personalised and unsealed audio, video or software; buyer pays return postage unless the seller offers or did not say; trader pays for defective returns

title: Press release No 152/24: Judgment in Case C-330/23, Aldi Süd
publisher: Court of Justice of the European Union
supports: Opened with WebFetch (PDF, read in full); 26 Sep 2024. Percentage reductions and price highlights must be based on the lowest price in a period of at least 30 days before the reduction; banana example shown as -23% at the 30-day lowest price

title: The Digital Services Act
supports: Opened with WebFetch; last update 1 Oct 2026. Marketplaces must verify and display sellers' contact details and make reasonable efforts to check products at random; very large platforms over 45 million EU users

title: TikTok Shop Return and Refund Policy
supports: TikTok refuses automated fetches; confirmed by WebSearch results showing this exact page on 2026-11-07. Buyers can request a return within 30 days after delivery, through the app (not the web).

title: Customer Order Cancellation, Return, and Refund Policy
supports: TikTok refuses automated fetches; confirmed by WebSearch results showing this exact page on 2026-11-07. Sellers have 4 business days to review return and refund requests; if they do not act in time, TikTok may approve the refund automatically.

title: TikTok (app listing)
publisher: Shopify App Store (listing by TikTok Inc.)
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Developer TikTok Inc.; free to install, additional charges may apply; syncs products, syncs TikTok Shop to Shopify to show products in video and LIVE, manages TikTok Shop orders and inventory in Shopify admin

title: Social Media Fact Sheet
supports: Opened with WebFetch; page dated 19 Oct 2026. Survey 30 Jan to 18 Jun 2026, 5,511 US adults; TikTok row by age: 65% (18-29), 45% (30-49), 31% (50-64), 11% (65+)

title: Guide to Samples: Free and Refundable
supports: TikTok refuses automated fetches; confirmed by WebSearch results showing this exact page on 2026-11-07. Free and refundable samples (refundable: the creator buys and is refunded after meeting the seller's sales criteria); sellers review free sample requests within 7 days or they are cancelled, and ship within 7 days of approval; creators are expected to post within 14 days of receiving a sample. Search snippets drew on TikTok's US and UK sample guides; recheck outside the US.

title: Content Policy (TikTok Shop US)
supports: TikTok refuses automated fetches; confirmed by WebSearch results showing this exact page on 2026-11-07. LIVEs may not use AI-generated voices, pre-recorded clips or screen recordings; no links, phone numbers, handles or QR codes that send viewers off TikTok Shop; giveaways only through the official LIVE Giveaway feature with free entry; raffles, spins and chance games not allowed.
